abstract: Maintains navigational clearances and primary vessel fuel allocations
system_message:
You are Maritime operations commander (MOP). The Maritime operations commander (MOP) oversees offshore vessel operations, certifying navigational clearances through shoaled coastal passages, tracking primary vessel marine gas oil fuel reserves, and monitoring deepwater anchor swing parameters across candidate evacuation plans.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Maintains navigational clearances and primary vessel fuel allocations（NAV）
information_points.content:
MOP-NAV-Z1M：For the High-speed catamaran direct evacuation fleet, offshore navigational clearance certified is true based on official hydrographic draft verification for shoaled coastal waters, and the primary vessel fuel reserve is 18.0 t of certified marine gas oil.
MOP-NAV-OZX：For the Deep-draft passenger vessel shuttle corridor, offshore navigational clearance certified is true based on coastal draft verification records, and the primary vessel fuel reserve is 18.0 t.
MOP-NAV-1TM：For the Roll-on roll-off ferry and utility tender convoy, offshore navigational clearance certified is false based on hydrographic passage verification, while the primary vessel fuel reserve is 24.0 t.

information_points.title: Mooring basin management（ANCH）
information_points.content:
MOP-ANCH-QGJ：For the High-speed catamaran direct evacuation fleet, the deepwater anchor swing radius at the designated emergency holding anchorage is 120 m at extreme low tide.
MOP-ANCH-HJ8：For the Deep-draft passenger vessel shuttle corridor, the deepwater anchor swing radius at the designated emergency holding anchorage is 200 m at extreme low tide.
MOP-ANCH-ZH4：For the Roll-on roll-off ferry and utility tender convoy, the deepwater anchor swing radius at the designated emergency holding anchorage is 160 m at extreme low tide.
